title: Chart Reading Challenge
summary: Read trend and structure on unseen simulated charts, and tell real breakouts from failed ones more often than not.

criteria.label: Pass the Charts, trends and structure checkpoint
Find the Trend: 16 or more of your last 20 right
Breakout or Fake: 7 or more of your last 10 right
Where Is the Stop: 8 or more of your last 10 right
